comment: Two big issues. 1) All the leaves still fall off the branch (which i have multiple times asked for most of them to stay) that still reads as the tree collapsing into a pile of dust. 2) because the whole thing just comes apart and falls directly downward, it looks unrealistic. Not sure what would cause this affect. If you cut the tree down, it should hinge at the trunk hit the ground and the bottom branches break off from the impact. If a big boulder or wind hit it, the branches could break off like this but it would move in a direction, not just unzip and fall to the ground
